records.jp: これ、お姉ちゃんたちの様子を見られるかも
records.en_original: We might be able to see what's happening to them.
records.en: We might be able to see what's happening to them.

records.jp: 前の世界でアタシらを殺しただけあって、<CR>簡単に倒せる相手じゃなさそうだな
records.en_original: After all, they killed us in the previous world—I doubt we can take them down easily.
records.en: After all, they killed us in the previous world—I doubt we can take them down easily.

records.jp: モモ、無理は禁物よ。<CR>紫乃の作り出した偽物とはいえ、相当な強敵だから
records.en_original: Careful, Momo. Even if it's just a fake made by Shino, it'll still be a strong enemy.
records.en: Careful, Momo. Even if it's just a fake made by Shino, it'll still be a strong enemy.

records.jp: わかってるさ。<CR>それより、陽桜莉と瑠夏は大丈夫かな？
records.en_original: Yeah, I know. But more importantly, I wonder if Hiori and Ruka are okay?
records.en: Yeah, I know. But more importantly, I wonder if Hiori and Ruka are okay?

records.jp: ……わからない。<CR>紫乃がどんな攻撃を仕掛けてくるか、予想もできないし
records.en_original: I don't know... There's no way to predict what kind of attacks Shino will throw at them.
records.en: I don't know... There's no way to predict what kind of attacks Shino will throw at them.

records.jp: なら、早いとこ行ってやらないとだな。<CR>こいつはアタシに任せて、陽桜莉と合流しろ
records.en_original: Then we better get over there, fast. Leave this one to me—go find Hiori and team up with her.
records.en: Then we better get over there, fast. Leave this one to me—go find Hiori and team up with her.

records.jp: そんな、一人じゃ無茶よ！
records.en_original: No way, it's too dangerous to leave you on your own!
records.en: No way, it's too dangerous to leave you on your own!

records.jp: 安心しろって、アタシは絶対に勝つ。<CR>じゃなきゃ、昨日の約束破っちまうことになるだろ？
records.en_original: Relax. I'm definitely going to win. Otherwise, I'd be breaking my promise from yesterday.
records.en: Relax. I'm definitely going to win. Otherwise, I'd be breaking my promise from yesterday.

records.jp: モモ……
records.en_original: Momo...
records.en: Momo...

records.jp: いよいよ、明日はコモン行きか…‥
records.en_original: So, tomorrow's finally the day we head to the Common...
records.en: So, tomorrow's finally the day we head to the Common...

records.jp: モモ、身体の方は平気？<CR>まだ本調子じゃないなら無理しなくても……
records.en_original: Momo, are you holding up okay? If you're not feeling 100%, you don't have to push yourself.
records.en: Momo, are you holding up okay? If you're not feeling 100%, you don't have to push yourself.

records.jp: それだってできなくなるかもしれないんだ。<CR>なら、アタシは喜んで無理するさ
records.en_original: Even that might not be an option soon. So, I'm happy to push myself while I still can.
records.en: Even that might not be an option soon. So, I'm happy to push myself while I still can.

records.jp: まだまだ、やりたいこともたくさんあるんだしな
records.en_original: There's still so much I want to do, after all.
records.en: There's still so much I want to do, after all.

records.jp: やりたいこと、か……
records.en_original: Things you want to do, huh?
records.en: Things you want to do, huh?

records.jp: なんだよ？<CR>美弦にだってそういうの、あるだろ？
records.en_original: Something strange about that? You've got things you want to do too, right Mio?
records.en: Something strange about that? You've got things you want to do too, right Mio?

records.jp: ……わからないわ
records.en_original: ...I'm not sure.
records.en: ...I'm not sure.

records.jp: は？　わからないってなんだよ。<CR>一つや二つあるだろ？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you mean you're not sure? You must have at least one or two goals in mind.
records.en: Huh? What do you mean you're not sure? You must have at least one or two goals in mind.

records.jp: 私は、ずっと陽桜莉のために生きてきたから……
records.en_original: My whole life, I've only ever lived for Hiori...
records.en: My whole life, I've only ever lived for Hiori...

records.jp: けど、今の陽桜莉は大切な人たちに囲まれてる。<CR>私がいなくても、ちゃんと幸せになれてる
records.en_original: But now Hiori is surrounded by people she cares about. She can be happy even without me being there for her.
records.en: But now Hiori is surrounded by people she cares about. She can be happy even without me being there for her.

records.jp: だから、私が今までみたいに何かをする必要は<CR>なくなっちゃったわけで……どうしよう……
records.en_original: So, I guess there's nothing left I really need to do anymore... What should I do?
records.en: So, I guess there's nothing left I really need to do anymore... What should I do?

records.jp: ……そっか。<CR>じゃあつまり、目下のところ暇ってわけだな
records.en_original: I see... So basically, you're saying you've got free time, then.
records.en: I see... So basically, you're saying you've got free time, then.

records.jp: ひ、暇って……まあ、間違いではないけど……
records.en_original: Free time? Well, you're not exactly wrong, but...
records.en: Free time? Well, you're not exactly wrong, but...

records.jp: なら、アタシのやりたいことに協力してくれよ
records.en_original: Then help me out with what I want to do!
records.en: Then help me out with what I want to do!

records.jp: モモのやりたいこと？
records.en_original: The things you want to do?
records.en: The things you want to do?

records.jp: ああ。美弦はさ、結構勉強できるんだろ？<CR>だからアタシに勉強を教えてくれ
records.en_original: Yeah. You're pretty smart, right, Mio? So why don't you help me study?
records.en: Yeah. You're pretty smart, right, Mio? So why don't you help me study?

records.jp: 構わないけど……驚いた。<CR>モモ、勉強が好きになったの？
records.en_original: Sure, but... I'm surprised. Do you like studying now, Momo?
records.en: Sure, but... I'm surprised. Do you like studying now, Momo?

records.jp: なわけあるか。<CR>むしろやらなくていいならやらねぇよ
records.en_original: No way. If I could avoid it, I wouldn't study at all!
records.en: No way. If I could avoid it, I wouldn't study at all!

records.jp: でも、どうせなら……おまえと一緒に大学生活ってのも<CR>面白いかなと思ってさ
records.en_original: But if I can, I think going to university with you sounds pretty fun.
records.en: But if I can, I think going to university with you sounds pretty fun.

records.jp: 大学って……あ、あれ？<CR>私、大学に行くなんて話したこと、あったかしら？
records.en_original: University... Wait, huh? Did I ever mention I was planning to go to college?
records.en: University... Wait, huh? Did I ever mention I was planning to go to college?

records.jp: さあね、多分ない。<CR>けど、どうせやることないなら、一緒に目指さないか？
records.en_original: Hmm, probably not. But if you don't have anything else to do, why not aim for it together with me?
records.en: Hmm, probably not. But if you don't have anything else to do, why not aim for it together with me?

records.jp: まあ、自分でも無理を言ってるのは分かってるけど、<CR>バディの美弦が一緒なら、頑張れるかなって
records.en_original: I know that's an unreasonable request, but if you're there with me, I feel like I'll be able to give it my all!
records.en: I know that's an unreasonable request, but if you're there with me, I feel like I'll be able to give it my all!

records.jp: ……リフレクターじゃなくて、ただの友達として<CR>並ぶのも、悪いもんじゃないだろうしな
records.en_original: ...Even if we're not Reflectors, just being regular friends side by side doesn't sound too bad at all.
records.en: ...Even if we're not Reflectors, just being regular friends side by side doesn't sound too bad at all.

records.jp: モモ……
records.en_original: Momo...
records.en: Momo...

records.jp: それと、ばあちゃんの墓参りも一緒に行こう。<CR>美弦のこと紹介したいし
records.en_original: Oh, and I wanna go visit my grandmother's grave together, too. I want to introduce you to her.
records.en: Oh, and I wanna go visit my grandmother's grave together, too. I want to introduce you to her.

records.jp: ま、そんなわけで他にもやりたいこと満載なんだ。<CR>暇なら手伝ってくれよ、バディだろ？
records.en_original: So yeah, there's a ton of other things I wanna do. If you're free, help me out. Okay, partner?
records.en: So yeah, there's a ton of other things I wanna do. If you're free, help me out. Okay, partner?

records.jp: ふふっ、なら私もモモに合わせて浪人しないとね
records.en_original: Hehe, in that case, I'll have to wait a few years to apply so you can catch up.
records.en: Hehe, in that case, I'll have to wait a few years to apply so you can catch up.

records.jp: おっ、言ったなこいつ！
records.en_original: Oh, you said it now!
records.en: Oh, you said it now!

records.jp: ふふっ……ありがとう、モモ。<CR>私にもやりたいことを作ってくれて
records.en_original: Hehe... Thank you, Momo. For reminding me there are things I want to do for myself, too.
records.en: Hehe... Thank you, Momo. For reminding me there are things I want to do for myself, too.

records.jp: 絶対に、無事に帰ってきましょう。<CR>大学も、お墓参りも、一緒に行きたいから
records.en_original: Let's definitely come back safe. Because I want to go to college together and visit your grandmother's grave with you, too.
records.en: Let's definitely come back safe. Because I want to go to college together and visit your grandmother's grave with you, too.

records.jp: ああ、約束だ
records.en_original: Yeah, it's a promise.
records.en: Yeah, it's a promise.

records.jp: ……必ず、勝って追いかけてきてくれるって<CR>信じてるから
records.en_original: I know you'll win and come chasing after us. I believe in you.
records.en: I know you'll win and come chasing after us. I believe in you.

records.jp: 当然だ……ほら、早く行けっ！！
records.en_original: Of course! Now go—and hurry!
records.en: Of course! Now go—and hurry!

records.jp: ……よかった。<CR>私、ちょっと安心しちゃった
records.en_original: Thank goodness. I feel a bit relieved now.
records.en: Thank goodness. I feel a bit relieved now.

records.jp: 安心？
records.en_original: Relieved?
records.en: Relieved?

records.jp: うん。<CR>お姉ちゃんのバディがモモさんでよかったな、って
records.en_original: Yeah. I'm just glad to see that Momo is such a good friend to my sister.
records.en: Yeah. I'm just glad to see that Momo is such a good friend to my sister.

records.jp: 私だと、いるだけでお姉ちゃんを縛り付けちゃうけど、<CR>モモさんはお姉ちゃんを引っ張ってってくれる
records.en_original: If it were me, just being there would probably weigh her down. But Momo pulls her along.
records.en: If it were me, just being there would probably weigh her down. But Momo pulls her along.

records.jp: ふふっ、確かに美弦さんのバディは、<CR>モモさん以外に考えられないね
records.en_original: Hehe, yeah, I honestly can't imagine anyone but Momo being Mio's partner.
records.en: Hehe, yeah, I honestly can't imagine anyone but Momo being Mio's partner.

records.jp: っと、山田さんの前では絶対言えないけど
records.en_original: But I'd never say that in front of Niina.
records.en: But I'd never say that in front of Niina.

records.jp: あはは、だねぇ
records.en_original: Haha, yeah, totally.
records.en: Haha, yeah, totally.

records.jp: ……二人とも、コモンから帰った後のことを<CR>すごく楽しそうに話してたね
records.en_original: Both of them were talking so happily about what they wanted to do after coming back from the Common.
records.en: Both of them were talking so happily about what they wanted to do after coming back from the Common.

records.jp: 聞いててすごく心が温かくなった。<CR>絶対に叶えてほしいな、って
records.en_original: Listening to that really warmed my heart. I truly hope their wishes comes true.
records.en: Listening to that really warmed my heart. I truly hope their wishes comes true.

records.jp: うん……間違いなんかじゃないよね？<CR>二人の話してたことって
records.en_original: Yeah... There was nothing wrong with what they were talking about, right?
records.en: Yeah... There was nothing wrong with what they were talking about, right?

records.jp: でも、この世界を終わらせるってことは、<CR>今見た想いまで否定することになるんだよね
records.en_original: But if this world ends, even feelings like that won't exist anymore.
records.en: But if this world ends, even feelings like that won't exist anymore.

records.jp: ……間違った世界の一つとして消されるから、<CR>多分、そういうことなんだと思う
records.en_original: Yeah, they'll probably be erased as part of this mistaken world...
records.en: Yeah, they'll probably be erased as part of this mistaken world...

records.jp: けど、それこそ間違った判断だと思う。<CR>あの想いや目標が消えるなんて、耐えられない
records.en_original: But I think that's wrong. I can't stand the thought of feelings and dreams like that being erased.
records.en: But I think that's wrong. I can't stand the thought of feelings and dreams like that being erased.

records.jp: だとすると……私たちがやろうとしてることって……
records.en_original: In that case, just what are we trying to accomplish right now?
records.en: In that case, just what are we trying to accomplish right now?

records.jp: このままいけば、二人とも元に戻ってくれそうだね
records.en_original: If things keep going like this, the two of you might finally return to normal.
records.en: If things keep going like this, the two of you might finally return to normal.

records.jp: でも、二人のフラグメントが不完全である以上、<CR>あまりのんびりはしていられない
records.en_original: But since your Fragments are still incomplete, we can't afford to take things too easy.
records.en: But since your Fragments are still incomplete, we can't afford to take things too easy.

records.jp: そのままだとフラグメントを覆う黒い力が、<CR>二人の想いを阻害し続ける
records.en_original: If we leave things as they are, that dark power surrounding your Fragments will keep blocking off your feelings.
records.en: If we leave things as they are, that dark power surrounding your Fragments will keep blocking off your feelings.

records.jp: その黒い力を取り払わない限り、<CR>このモヤモヤした感覚は残り続けるってことね……
records.en_original: Unless we get rid of that darkness, this gloomy feeling will never go away...
records.en: Unless we get rid of that darkness, this gloomy feeling will never go away...

records.jp: でも、だんだん自分の状態がわかってきたのは確かだよ
records.en_original: Still, I'm definitely starting to understand my own condition more and more.
records.en: Still, I'm definitely starting to understand my own condition more and more.

records.jp: 早くフラグメントの破片を見つけよう。<CR>私たちの想いを、ハッキリさせるために
records.en_original: Let's hurry and find the Fragment shards so we can make our feelings crystal clear.
records.en: Let's hurry and find the Fragment shards so we can make our feelings crystal clear.
